opportunities.name: Hyper AP skirmisher
opportunities.objective: Test hyper ap skirmisher against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Mini Hyper's helper calculation contains 1.0 AP magic damage per third attack/ability, and Hop grants six seconds of attack speed. Nashor and Terminus support mixed attack pressure; Mega R has AP scaling but remains physical, so the build must survive its forced form change.
opportunities.requiredState: Begin in Mini with low Rage and maintain one target's marks.
opportunities.failure: Mega form removes Hyper's repeat pattern and the ranged safety.
opportunities.test: Compare Hyper procs before transformation and damage after transformation.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Mega R does not become magic from its AP ratio; phantom-hit Hyper stacks need testing.

opportunities.name: Boulder spell bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test boulder spell bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Mega Boulder has a 1.4 AD physical ratio and picking it up refunds cooldown; Bloodmail adds AD from purchased health while Shojin supports basic spells. Sundered Sky rewards the attack after Mega control, but Mini Q catches and slow-based spacing remain necessary between transformations.
opportunities.requiredState: Reach Mega at the intended fight and recover a safe boulder.
opportunities.failure: Rage timing or unsafe pickups prevent the planned second cast.
opportunities.test: Measure Q casts and healing across one full Mini-to-Mega cycle.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Mega bonus stats and boulder refund are conditional, not always-active item scaling.

ruledOut.reason: Mega R does not become magic from its AP ratio; phantom-hit Hyper stacks need testing.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Hyper AP skirmisher
builds.summary: Test hyper ap skirmisher against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test hyper ap skirmisher against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Mini Hyper's helper calculation contains 1.0 AP magic damage per third attack/ability, and Hop grants six seconds of attack speed. Nashor and Terminus support mixed attack pressure; Mega R has AP scaling but remains physical, so the build must survive its forced form change.
testPlan: Required state: Begin in Mini with low Rage and maintain one target's marks.
Compare Hyper procs before transformation and damage after transformation.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Mega form removes Hyper's repeat pattern and the ranged safety.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Mega R does not become magic from its AP ratio; phantom-hit Hyper stacks need testing.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Riftmaker, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Mini Gnar Passive: Every third Attack or Ability on the same enemy deals an additional @spell.GnarW:MiniTotalDamage@ plus @spell.GnarW:MiniPercentHPDamage*100@% max Health magic damage and grants @spell.GnarR:RHyperMovementSpeedPercent@% Move Speed decaying over @spell.GnarW:MiniHasteDuration@ seconds.

Mini Gnar Passive: Increase Hyper's Move Speed.

Mega Gnar: Gnar tosses nearby enemies, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (1) × AP + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing them by [45]% for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75] seconds. Enemies that hit a wall instead take [(200 / 300 / 400 + (1) × AP + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((150) × (0.01))] physical damage and are Stunned.

Gnar generates Rage by dealing and receiving damage. At max Rage his next Ability transforms him into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds.

Mini Gnar: Gain [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=1, changes=[{"mLevel": 16, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Move Speed, [characterLevelInterpolation(0.055 → 0.99; raw flags preserved)] Attack Speed, and [characterLevelInterpolation(0 → 100; raw flags preserved)] Attack Range.

Mega Gnar: Gain [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw)] max Health, [characterLevelInterpolation(3.5 → 54.5; raw flags preserved)] Armor, [characterLevelInterpolation(3.5 → 63; raw flags preserved)] Magic Resist, and [characterLevelInterpolation(6 → 48.5; raw flags preserved)] Attack Damage.

Mini Gnar: Gnar leaps, gaining @spell.GnarE:MinibAS*100@% Attack Speed for @spell.GnarE:MiniASDuration@ seconds. If Gnar lands on a unit he will bounce off it, traveling further. Bouncing off an enemy deals @spell.GnarE:MiniTotalDamage@ physical damage and briefly Slows by @spell.GnarE:MoveSpeedMod*-100@%.
